test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to

be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given

statements.

Statements:

All apples are mangoes.

All mangoes are lemons.

All lemons are kiwis.

Conclusions:

(I) All apples are lemons.

(II) All mangoes are kiwis.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bce150fb31753928f0b960570cd0eb1553bec7197c53e6fd8ff41d89d66c470.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) All apples are lemons → Follow (As all apples are mangoes and all mangoes are lemons. As wholes apples comes in mangoes which whole comes in lemons, therefore it is true.)

(II) All mangoes are kiwis → Follow (As all mangoes are lemons and all lemons are kiwis. As wholes mangoes comes in lemons which whole comes in kiwis, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
